residual_risks.title: No clean Linux/Python 3.11 CI execution of H1 is in the package
Isolated reproduction installed from an offline wheelhouse repacked from local caches, not from a package index
Dependency is an unpinned floor (`jsonschema>=4.20.0`) resolved from PyPI at hook-install time
Parent validation logs are bare outputs without captured commands, exit codes, or environment preconditions
The CT hook's `files:` filter excludes `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, so the changed-file pre-commit for H1 itself skipped the hook
